$comment: REVERSAL_NO_WICK_IFVG setup (reversal spec section 6). Counter-bias: HTF no-wick/IMR origin -> rebalance -> reaction -> confirmation -> arm. Research defaults; any change must bump strategyVersion. No fixed probabilities.

biasGate.$comment: Allow the counter-bias reversal only when a D1 origin outranks the bias, or the HTF bias is non-directional.

confirmation.$comment: After the reaction, any ONE of IFVG_FLIP (confirmed IFVG at the origin) / NEW_FVG / IMR (from the reversal leg, in the reversal direction) arms the setup within flipWindowBars.

entry.$comment: After ARM, price must retest the entry zone within windowBars; if the target is reached first the setup is ENTRY_MISSED (do not chase).
